name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-informatica-migrator
description: Migrate Informatica ETL (IDMC/IICS cloud mapping JSON, PowerCenter 10.x XML) to Oracle AI Data Platform: mappings become PySpark notebooks, workflows become AIDP jobs with the session dependency graph and Quartz schedules.
